lines.text: Namaste! I am Dr. Kapil. ... In the next four minutes, you will unlock three superpowers: speed, memory and focus. ... And you will see the change yourself.
First, a quick Brain Check, so we know where you start today. ... Relax, and do your natural best.
Most people read at the speed they speak. ... Your eyes can move much faster. ... Let them follow the light.
Here is the secret. ... Your brain loves pictures and stories. ... Let's link five new words into one crazy story. ... See each picture in your mind.
A huge gorilla...
opens a giant suitcase.
Instead of clothes, curd pours out of the suitcase!
The curd soaks a flying drone...
and the heavy drone falls right into your tiffin.
A cheeky squirrel...
jumps into a big cooker.
The cooker whistles and shoots out popcorn!
The popcorn lands on a sleeping buffalo...
and the buffalo sits right on your T.V. remote.
Now see the whole story once more in your mind.
Sit comfortably. ... Look softly at the glowing dot.
Breathe in.
And slowly breathe out.
Beautiful. ... Your mind is calm and sharp.
Wow! ... You just saw it yourself.
Great effort! ... In thirty days of practice, this grows step by step.
Here is your Brain Unlock report. ... These are your own, real numbers.
